definitions.expressionSemantics: Every variable ranges over Q. All calls mean literal polynomial substitution with disjoint witness blocks. Model-evaluation and sum-of-squares recipes conjoin their constraints by summing squared polynomials. A product-composition recipe multiplies its callee polynomials. Finite expansion gives one polynomial in Z[t,w].

scalarNodeEncoding.call: args=[library template index,parameter node indices...,witnessStart]. The callee root polynomial is substituted literally. Nodes are topologically ordered.
scalarNodeEncoding.psi_component: args=[fixed integer index expression,x0 node,x1 node,y0 node,y1 node,component 0 or 1]
scalarNodeEncoding.finite_guard_product: args=[fixed cutoff expression,fifteen coordinate nodes in point-major order]

definitions.templateMeaning: Only nodes and root define the template polynomial; formulas and metadata are diagnostic. The first parameterCount local variables are parameters. The remaining local variables are existential witnesses.

modelRecordEncoding.sourceVariables: Each row is [source variable index,point reference,naturalWitnessStart or null]. A non-null start contributes a call to the operationTemplates.natural polynomial on that point.
modelRecordEncoding.constantDefinitions: Each record contributes its scalar template polynomial on the local generator P and record.point, using record.witnessStart. Its fixed coefficient is bound in library.fixedConstants.
modelRecordEncoding.operation0: [0,source node,left point,right point,output point,witnessStart] contributes the addition template polynomial.
modelRecordEncoding.operation1: [1,source node,left point,right point,output point,witnessStart] contributes the multiplication template polynomial.
modelRecordEncoding.operation2: [2,source node,parameter point 0,parameter point 1,parameter point 2,output point,witnessStart] contributes the power-value recipe polynomial.
modelRecordEncoding.rootEquality: The five coordinate differences of its two point references are constraints.
modelRecordEncoding.diagnosticFields: Source node numbers, sourceNodePoints, source hashes and provenance identify the translation; they add no constraints beyond the listed calls and rootEquality.

definitions.compositionMeaning: For sum-of-squares-composition-v1, each call contributes its callee polynomial at call.parameters and call.witnessStart; sum their squares. For product-composition-v1, multiply the same callee polynomials instead. Empty sums and products are 0 and 1. kind=template selects a library template, kind=recipe a named earlier recipe. Parameters [var,i] select local variable i. All witness blocks remain disjoint, including unused disjunction branches.
definitions.rootVariableOrdering: The integers recipe has the one free rational variable t at index 0. Every other variable is an existential rational witness. The value recipe has five code coordinates followed by t.
definitions.pointReferences: A nonnegative point reference s means variables s,...,s+4. -1 means (1,0,0,0,0). -2 means (0,g0,-145,g1,g2). -3 means (0,g0,-145,-g1,-g2), using the recipe's three generator variables.
definitions.modelRecipeConstraints: Include the three generator constraints; each listed natural call; each scalar-constant call on P and its output; every listed add/multiply/power-evaluation call; and the five differences in rootEquality. Square each polynomial and add. No source operation is a separate zero condition unless expressed by this recipe.
definitions.libraryCallBinding: For a callee with p parameter variables, replace its variables 0,...,p-1 by the supplied scalar expressions; replace its variable p+j by the caller variable witnessStart+j.

psiNormalization.definition: psi_n=f_n(x) when n is odd; psi_n=2*y*f_n(x) when n is even; psi_-n=-psi_n.
psiNormalization.recurrenceOdd: For m>=2 set L=f_(m+2)*f_m^3, R=f_(m-1)*f_(m+1)^3 and D=16*(x^3+A*x)^2. f_(2m+1)=D*L-R for even m, and L-D*R for odd m.
psiNormalization.componentMeaning: psi_component returns the indicated coefficient in basis 1,sqrt(2), after these finite polynomial recurrences and field multiplication are expanded.

fixedPointCodes.positive: For n>0 evaluate g=psi_n at P, x_n=x(P)-psi_(n+1)(P)*psi_(n-1)(P)/g^2, y_n=psi_(2n)(P)/(2*g^4). Its code is (0,coeff0(x_n),coeff1(x_n),coeff0(y_n),coeff1(y_n)).
fixedPointCodes.negative: iota(-n) is obtained from iota(n) by negating the two y coefficients.
fixedPointCodes.nonzeroDenominators: P is nontorsion, so these fixed coefficient calculations have nonzero denominators.

finiteGuard.bound: T is the fixed integer from fixedConstants, never a quantified variable.
finiteGuard.factor: For a,b,c in [-T,T] with a*b!=c, write the fifteen coordinates of iota(a),iota(b),iota(c) as A_j/B_j with B_j>0, gcd(A_j,B_j)=1. Put D=product_j B_j. The factor is sum_j (D*X_j-(D/B_j)*A_j)^2.
finiteGuard.polynomial: The product of these factors. An empty product is 1.

coefficientAlgorithms.catalogue: For every 1<=r<W with gcd(r,W)=1, list the first k primes p>B with p congruent to r modulo W. catalogue_product is their product and catalogue_max their maximum.
coefficientAlgorithms.localMultiplier: For N>0, least_formal_multiple(N) is the least m>=1 such that 1/x([m]P)=(a+b*sqrt(2))/c, c>0, gcd(a,b,c)=1, satisfies N^4|a, N^4|b, gcd(c,N)=1.
coefficientAlgorithms.termination: The prime lists exist by Dirichlet's theorem. The least formal multiple exists because the prescribed local formal subgroups have finite index. Other operators are ordinary finite integer arithmetic.

finitePolynomialConstructors.fixed_integer: Substitute the fixed integer expression; no quantified variables occur in it.
finitePolynomialConstructors.psi_component: Component 0 or 1 of the classical psi_n(x,y) for the fixed integer n, with psi_2=2y. Expand by the normalized recurrences in elliptic-division-polynomials.js.
finitePolynomialConstructors.finite_guard_product: Product over a,b,c in [-T,T] with a*b!=c of the integer denominator-cleared squared-distance factors specified in rational-model-assembly.js.

intendedTheorem: For every rational t, existence of rational witnesses is equivalent to t being an integer, conditional on the exact G,H,L,RC arithmetic inputs and the source recognizer/compiler theorems.
limitations: The source precision polynomial and signed encodings concern integer indices, never the external rational t.
No proof that Z is Diophantine in Q is claimed by this artifact alone.
Finite polynomial constructors define literal finite substitutions; the monomial expansion is not materialized.
